description: A nested helper preserves the enclosing whole-rule boundary with positive sign and tag reads at depth 2 (engine §4.2).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text X r | Y r
%rule r ($a:aa ((cc ≻ dd) ≻ ee) ≻ $b:bb) :: ∅
%conditions $a.tags = A ∧ $.preceded-by(X)
%rule aa A
%rule bb C
%rule cc B
%rule dd B
%rule ee B
